description:
About our brand and products: JubileeTV connects a senior's existing TV to a caregiver's smartphone app, so families can stay close without anyone having to learn new tech. Features like remote TV control, auto-answer video calling, drop-in check-ins, on-screen reminders, and family photo sharing work right on the TV your loved one already uses. No tablets, no new devices, no behavior change required from them. Just connection, made simpler.

What makes us different: Most caregiving tech asks the older adult to change. JubileeTV doesn't. It works on the TV they're already watching, with zero setup required on their end. Caregivers get real peace of mind, and the person they're caring for doesn't even have to know the app exists. That's genuinely rare in this space.

How affiliates can earn: Earn $50 for every new subscriber you refer through your unique link. Your affiliate link gives your audience $39 off any plan at getjubileetv.com, so there's something real in it for them too. Commissions are paid on the 7th of each month for orders placed at least 60 days prior. Track everything in your partner portal. The more your audience trusts you, the better this converts — this is a product people actually thank their family members for buying.

How to promote us: The people who buy JubileeTV are usually adult children who are juggling a lot and worried about a parent who doesn't live with them. Content that resonates: real talk about the caregiver experience, honest product walkthroughs, and stories about what it actually feels like to be tech support and all the things for someone you love. Educational content about aging-in-place and family caregiving also performs well. We can provide product access, assets, and talking points, just ask.

Other information: We're a small team that moves fast and takes partnerships seriously. If something isn't working or you have ideas, we want to hear them. Reach out to partners@getjubileetv.com with questions, content requests, or just to say hi. We're genuinely glad you're here.

3. Promotional Activity Requirements and Restrictions

Because you receive a commission for referrals, the FTC requires you to disclose your material connection to JubileeTV whenever you promote our products. What that looks like depends on the channel:

  • Printed materials: Any printed flyers, handouts, or collateral you distribute must include a disclosure statement such as "Shared by a JubileeTV affiliate partner. The person who gave you this may receive a referral commission."


Accuracy and Conduct

All Promotional Activity must:

  • Use only accurate information about JubileeTV's products, features, and pricing. If you are unsure about a product detail, direct the person to getjubileetv.com or contact partners@getjubileetv.com before making a claim.

Online-Specific Restrictions

Note on promo codes: Promo codes are valid only on getjubileetv.com and cannot be used on Amazon or other third-party retailers. Please make this clear when sharing your code with anyone.


4. Commissions and Payment

Your commission rate, eligible products, and payment terms are as displayed in your Partner Dashboard at partners.getjubileetv.com/dashboard ("Dashboard Terms"). The Dashboard Terms are incorporated into this Agreement by reference.


Qualifying Transactions

A "Qualifying Transaction" means a purchase made by a customer who: (i) arrives via your assigned affiliate link or uses your assigned promo code; and (ii) completes a paid order that is not canceled, refunded, or charged back as of the payout date.

The following are not Qualifying Transactions:

  • Self-purchases or purchases made by your employees, household members, or immediate family.

Transactions that result in chargebacks or refunds will not be paid. We use cookies to track referrals; if a customer clears their cookies or disables cookie tracking, we cannot attribute that transaction to you.

The cookie tracking window is stated in your Dashboard. Within that window, qualifying purchases made by a customer who clicked your link are automatically attributed to you, without requiring an additional click.
